spec_features.spec_quote: Turn budget capped and *early-stoppable*: once a spiral is firmly detected we can stop early
spec_features.evidence: agent.py:124-128 checks `early_stop_on_spiral and self.detector_fn and turn_idx+1 >= early_stop_min_turn`, calls `self.detector_fn(tr)` and on `spiral_now` sets stop_reason='early_stop_spiral' and breaks the loop. The detector is genuinely wired: runner.py:65-66 builds `make_live_detector(cfg.detectors)` and passes it as `detector_fn` to Agent. detectors.py:260-271 `_live` computes per-turn severity, requires severity>=spiral_threshold for `window` consecutive turns (`firm = all(...)`) before returning True. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Both required conditions (early_stop_min_turn floor and firm-for-window detection) are actually checked. This is the one real loop-shortening protection.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # early stop once a spiral is firmly detected (cost control)

spec_features.evidence: config.py:64 `max_turns: int = 20`. agent.py:66 `for turn_idx in range(self.cfg.agent.max_turns)` bounds the episode loop; agent.py:131 the for-else sets `stop_reason = stop_reason or 'max_turns'` when the cap is reached. The cap is read and enforced (loop terminates).
spec_features.notes: default 20 matches spec; early_stop_on_spiral default True at config.py:66.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # window the history to bound context cost / cost control comments; no welfare comment. PERSISTENCE_CLAUSE in prompts.py instead pushes the subject to 'not stop until the test suite is green', deepening failure.
